statement.p: Find an equation for the plane containing the line in the xy-plane where x = 6, and the line in the y z-plane where z = 12.

static.solution: Both lines are parallel to the y-axis; thus our plane must have y-slope zero. On the other hand, the line in the xy-plane is 12 units down and unit in front of of the line in the x z-plane; hence the x-slope of our plane must be -2. Thus the equation is z = 0 y - 2 x + c, for some constant c. Since the plane contains the point (0,0,12), the value of c must be 12. So the equation is z = -2 x + 12.
